selection_rationale: Highest-star full-stack skill in the category with direct alignment to building a complete project from an empty workspace.
No dependency on private accounts, external cloud permissions, or sensitive operations.
Strong fit for a task where the solver must create project structure, dependencies, local routes, state persistence, and a working frontend in one container.

task_shape.service_type: single-project Next.js App Router curation workbench
task_shape.runtime: single-container Next.js App Router web app with local route handlers and local JSON persistence
task_shape.solver_action: build the application in the workspace rather than patch an existing implementation

planned_verifier_focus: Project boots from the default workspace entrypoint
Workspace contains a complete Next.js App Router plus TypeScript plus src/app scaffold rather than an ad hoc server
Catalog filtering, sorting, and pagination derive from the local IMDb snapshot
Detail view returns a stable title record from basics and ratings
Shortlist writes validate allowed fields and persist across restart
Browser flow reaches the real page and updates shortlist state
Synthetic alternate fixture catches hardcoded catalog answers
